## Flagship Research: S-SPARC

- Project Name: S-SPARC (Smart Personal Assistant for Responsible Consumption)
- Delegation Team: Yehezkiel David Setiawan (Lead Researcher), MAS RUSDI BARBER (Co-Developer), Archangela Sheilla Haryanto, advised by Dr. Oscar Karnalim.
- Problem Addressed: Excessive energy and computational resource consumption caused by unguided "lazy prompting" of Large Language Models (LLMs) in academia.
- Core Mechanism: Tiered semantic retrieval caching (FAISS), diagnostic pedagogical gating (C-I-O-E: Context, Intent, Obstacle, Attempt), and gamified carbon-saving incentives.
- Empirical Results:
  - 83.94% reduction in API token consumption across 2,122,873 tokens.
  - Tested in controlled academic trials with 60 university students.
  - Academic performance improvement with large effect size (Cohen's d = 1.54, +33.7% gain).
